description: This file is a JUnit test class for testing SSLContext creation in the SSLContextCreator class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines test methods to create SSL contexts with different configurations and references external SSL and test certificate resources.

classes.name: SSLContextCreatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for SSLContextCreator, extending AbstractSSLContextTest, verifying SSL context creation logic.

methods.name: createSSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext with specified trusted certificates, hostname, and credentials, using SSLContextCreator.

methods.name: createAcceptAnySSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext that trusts any certificate using AcceptAnyTrustManager.
